messages:
maya: Starting bring-up for magnet-weights-30b-q8 on dedicated pool (longctx focus). Seeing small but consistent drift around the 131072 token mark on streamed prefills.
rafi: Minimal repro please? prefill or decode side-effect?
maya: Prefill. We stream a 140k token document, then append a short continuation. Model logits look sane but next-token sequence has a tiny flip rate increase right at 131072.
joanne: 131072 boundary — sounds like a 128k fence/tiling issue rather than classic RoPE wrap. Which runtime + compile flags?
maya: runtime=rdx-runtime:v2.10.0-q8, kernels=fused-attn-int8, prefetch_chunk=64B, kv-seq-align unset (default). Deploy started: magnet-weights-30b-q8 -> pool-dedicated-5 (canary)
rafi: paste the KV offset dump snippet? that helps narrow indexing vs scaling.
maya: snippet:
```
[2026-03-02T02:11:09Z] prefill_part=0 tokens=131072 kv_offset=131072
[2026-03-02T02:11:09Z] prefill_part=1 tokens=8192   kv_offset=139264
[2026-03-02T02:11:09Z] stitch: expected_offset=139264 seen_offset=139260
```
rafi: mismatch by 4 tokens. Hmm. smaller gap — suggests a pad/rounding to 16B vs 64B or an off-by-sub-block when computing final memcpy length.
joanne: Also consider RoPE rescale interaction. Are we applying rescale during key prefill? try with `--rope-mode=rotate` and `--rope-rescale=1.0` vs `0.5` to see if error correlates.
ci-bot: longctx/rope-rescale fuzz job failed on canary (job id: ci-1758881234-fuzz). See: https://ci.redwood/1758881234/fuzz (log attached)
rafi: good idea. run quick A/B: rescale=1.0 (baseline) vs 0.5 (quant-friendly). also test `--kv-seq-align=16` and `--kv-seq-align=64`.
maya: ran the three combos on canary-5: only the combinations with `prefetch_chunk=64B + kv-seq-align=unset` showed the 4-token gap. forcing `--kv-seq-align=16` removed the stitch gap.
joanne: that pins it to alignment policy + prefetch chunk math. likely compute of final_block = (bytes + pad) & ~align_mask had an incorrect mask for q8 kernels.
rafi: please open a short reproducer in /mnt/experiments/1758881234/ with: sequence lengths [131068,131070,131071,131072,131073] and the tiny-doc prompt that triggers the issue. Add a fuzz harness in longctx CI that tries neighbours around power-of-two boundaries.
maya: created experiment dir and uploaded dumps + minimal script. scheduled nightly runs on perf-runner-3. leaving notes in the PR.
joanne: i'll add a regression rule to rollout: block if token_accuracy_drop > 0.5% at >100k context vs fp16 baseline, and alert on any stitch_gap_bytes > 0.
maya: PR: rdx/runtime: rollback tentative memcpy pad->64B change for q8 path + add CI fuzz test. linking shortly. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: model deploy succeeded: magnet-weights-30b-q8 -> pool-dedicated-5 (canary)
rafi: follow-up: include quantized variants (q4, q8) in matrix and run HELPFULNESS_BENCH at longctx sizes after regression fix. we'll compare token-level divergence + latency/cost delta.
maya: will post results tomorrow. logs & dumps: /mnt/experiments/1758881234/ (CI job artifacts attached).
